advice.claim: Use a sales fact sheet to help customers understand the story and unique benefits of a product beyond its basic function.
advice.quote: the sales fact sheet was an awesome touch helps us understand the story because obviously at first impression it could just seem like a body wash

advice.claim: Bundle products together to help justify a higher price point.
advice.quote: what would you bundle this with specifically is there another product that you currently carry that you could see bundled together

advice.claim: Use simplified product combinations to introduce multiple products to clients without overwhelming them.
advice.quote: We are always telling our clients how important it is to have multiple products in their routine. This is a great way to introduce that to them in a simplified way without throwing a thousand bottles at them.

advice.claim: Put the product in the customer's hand to create a sense of ownership.
advice.quote: when we're at the salon we always like to put the product in their hand because that's ownership

advice.claim: Make the sales process easier for the customer to increase conversion.
advice.quote: i always when i do sales trainings always like make things easier people because that's how you sell
